definitions.T: all placed rows of the level, decor included (matches 关卡参数生成规则.xlsx)
definitions.targets: stageGroupIds; count = placed instances of the same-named item, null when the name does not resolve
definitions.stack: carrier row followed by isNested rows; size = carrier + riders; sets = repeats of the same item tuple
definitions.motion: level has any hasWaypoint row; moving = number of hasWaypoint rows
definitions.layout: density = T per 100 square units of camera view; nn_median = median nearest-neighbour distance (units); crowd = share of items with a neighbour within 1.0 unit
definitions.split: per-category item counts, only when every itemGuid resolves (unresolved non-multiples of 3 count as decor)
